The spreadsheet and a lot of nagging

Spreadsheets break down.

Tracking COIs across dozens of vendors in a spreadsheet is error-prone and hard to keep current.

Too much nagging.

You end up emailing and calling vendors repeatedly to get updated certificates before they expire.

Gaps hide in the details.

It's hard to know at a glance which vendors are non-compliant or what's actually missing from a certificate.

Expirations sneak up.

Without a system, policies expire unnoticed and create liability exposure.

How it works

01

Upload or forward

Add vendors or have them upload via magic link (no account). Bulk import existing PDFs.

02

Extract

AI extracts coverage types, limits, policy dates, and additional-insured status from ACORD 25 certificates.

03

Check against your requirements

Compare against your template. Gaps are flagged clearly with what needs to be fixed.

04

Chase automatically

Reminders go to vendors and their insurance agents. Low-confidence extractions go to review queue.

Features

Set requirements once

Define coverage requirements in a reusable template. Apply across all vendors and see compliance at a glance.

Vendors upload without creating an account

Magic link lets vendors upload their COI PDF with no registration or password.

See where every extracted value comes from

Click any extracted field to see it highlighted in the original PDF for auditability.

Human review when the AI isn't sure

Uncertain extractions go to a review queue - see PDF side-by-side and approve, edit, or request re-upload.

Reminders to vendors and their agents

Automatic reminders to both parties before expiration, with full history.

Import existing COIs, get a gap report fast

Bulk import up to ~200 PDFs. Get organized results quickly.

Get a free COI gap audit in 24 hours

What you send: up to ~10-20 COI PDFs or a link, vendor list, and your requirements (or we'll suggest a template). What you get: gap report, expirations coming due, specific gaps called out, recommendations. No obligation.

Privacy: We only use files for your gap report. Not used to train public models. We do not verify coverage with insurers.

FAQ

Do you verify coverage with insurers?

No. We do not verify coverage with insurers. We extract and check information from the certificate document against your requirements.

What forms do you support?

ACORD 25 first, US only.

What happens when extraction is unsure?

Goes to the human review queue. You'll see the PDF side-by-side and can approve, edit, or request re-upload.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes, you can cancel anytime. Access remains until the end of your billing period.

CertClerk

CertClerk is a document tracking tool. We do not verify coverage with insurers or provide legal advice. US only, ACORD 25 first.
